title: Cavity-mediated probabilistic magic $T$-gate injection
summary: Non-Clifford gates are a necessary resource for universal quantum computation, yet their fault-tolerant implementation typically relies on magic-state distillation, which incurs significant overhead in qubit count and circuit depth. In this work, we propose a probabilistic cavity-based magic-state injection protocol.
